title: Holiday Card Send Weekly Mailing Time Trend
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holiday:card mailing_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(mailing_minutes) as avg_duration, max(mailing_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst mailing time for holiday card send events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture mailing_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average mailing time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether holiday card send tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
